description:
attention detail for one head, no controls of its own except a threshold slider. input head = {layer, head} selects rows of the data (layer, head, q, k, w); tokens from input toks (pos, token).
    left: the 15 tokens written in a row twice, queries on the top line and keys on the bottom line, arcs from each query down to its keys with stroke width and opacity by w; hover a query token to isolate its arcs and print its top-3 keys with weights. a slider 'hide arcs below' 0–0.5, start 0.05.
    right: the full 15×15 matrix for the same head, hover-synced with the arcs. title 'layer L · head H · <pattern>'. re-render when head changes.
theme_description:
Minimal instrument, print quality. Nothing on screen that is not data, a control, or a label a reader needs to read the data.

## Text
No title, subtitle, heading, description, instructions, hints, tips, how-to text, legend prose, footers, or status sentences. No emoji, check marks, crosses, exclamation marks, capitals for emphasis, or promotional tone. Labels are lowercase or sentence case, terse, and appear only where they carry a value (a count line, a time on a handle, the name of the selected mark). Numbers use tabular figures. If a control needs explaining, redesign the control instead of adding text.

## Type
One typeface: system-ui, -apple-system, Inter, Helvetica, sans-serif. 11-13px labels, 12-14px values, weight 400, weight 600 only for the single emphasized value. Monospace (ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo) only for times, coordinates and code.

## Color
Paper #ffffff, ink #111111, grey #777777, hairline #d9d9d9, faint fill #f2f2f2. One accent #d9480f for the current selection or target. Status colours only where they encode a state: open #2b8a3e, closed #c92a2a, unknown grey. Nothing else is coloured. No gradients, shadows, glows, rounded cards, pills, or tinted panels. Buttons and chips: hairline border, no fill; the active one is filled ink with white text.

## Marks
Thin. 1px hairlines, 1.5px data lines, 2px for the selected route. Points 5-7px. Draggable handles: 7px filled ink or accent with a 1.5px white stroke and an invisible 16px hit area. Area fills 8-15% opacity.

## Maps
Light grey basemap with no API key: Esri World Light Gray Canvas, https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x} (maxZoom 16, attribution 'Esri, HERE, Garmin, OpenStreetMap contributors'), so the data carries the colour. Never use CARTO or Stadia tiles. Small attribution, zoom control bottom-right.

## Layout
White ground, 12px padding, flat. A side panel is separated by a hairline, not boxed. Tables: hairline rows, right-aligned numbers, no zebra striping. Space instead of borders.

## Motion
None beyond the direct response to the pointer. State changes apply within 150ms, no easing flourishes.
